g.title: note
g.text: Host allocation: facade + supervisor share iso15118_chrg.c.
Concrete EXI / registry and part of session mapping live in the wire runner.
Optional OpenSSL TLS / crypto are host providers; they do not implement PnC.
The imported ChargeControl / ChargeParameters ABI remains supplier dependent.
